text:
jordyn: Hey team  first day here. On an M2 Air and I'm using fish shell (switched from zsh). I followed the dotfiles installer but asdf shims aren't taking. `which node` -> /usr/bin/node. Any fish-specific tips? Also can't find REDWOOD_API_KEY docs  where to store locally for quick testing?
samir: welcome! :wave: Fish is a little different: add to ~/.config/fish/config.fish instead of .zprofile. Example: `set -gx PATH $HOME/.asdf/shims $HOME/.asdf/bin $PATH` and then `status --is-interactive; and source (asdf init - | psub)` — or `bass` plugin to eval sh init. After that run `asdf reshim nodejs`.
samir: also check `brew --prefix` is /opt/homebrew; if it's /usr/local you might have x86 brew which causes build issues for ruby/gems.
jordyn: ok did that, node now shows the asdf version. thanks. for REDWOOD_API_KEY I saw a vault entry in 1Password but not sure which one to use for local dev.
carmen: we keep personal dev keys in 1Password -> Redwood -> Personal Dev Keys. If you need a new one, ping #support or open a ticket. For local workflows we prefer direnv: add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` to a local .envrc and `direnv allow`. Avoid committing keys to dotfiles.
jordyn: ran into GPG prompt issues when importing commit key: pinentry not found. any mac fixes?
samir: `brew install pinentry-mac` then in ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf set `pinentry-program /opt/homebrew/bin/pinentry-mac` and export `GPG_TTY=$(tty)` in fish: `set -gx GPG_TTY (tty)`. Restart agent: `gpgconf --kill gpg-agent; gpgconf --launch gpg-agent`.
devex-bot: (bot) Hi jordyn! Need setup pairing? Reply "pair" and I'll DM a calendar for DevEx. Also see onboarding checklist: https://handbook.redwood.dev/onboarding/dev-setup.
jordyn: awesome, pinentry fix worked. One oddity: my ssh-key isn't auto-loading to mac keychain with fish. Any tips?
carmen: use `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain path/to/key` and add `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` to your fish config, plus `ssh-agent` env setup in config. We have a small script in dotfiles `scripts/ssh-load.sh` that handles fish-safe loading.
jordyn: perfect. Everything green for now. I'll book a pairing slot later if anything else crops up. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
